name: Dana Kouri no Jouu Wei Wana
original_name: ダーナ氷の女王 猥罠
source:
This story unfolds on TIA, a planet very similar to Earth. 

Dana is the princess of the Silent Island and she is revered as the priestess of the sacred dragon that protects the island, and only a pure priestess can connect with the powerful sacred dragon. 

Fearing the power of the sacred dragon, she is kidnapped by the Desert Witch...
translation:
这个故事发生在TIA，一颗与地球非常相似的星球。

达娜是寂静岛的公主，她被尊为守护岛屿的圣龙女祭司，只有纯洁的女祭司才能与强大的圣龙产生联系。

由于害怕圣龙的力量，她被沙漠女巫绑架了……
